'''Chinatsu Akasaki''' (Japanese: '''赤﨑千夏''' ''Akasaki Chinatsu'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Akasaki was born on August 10, 1987 in {{wp|Minamikyūshū, Kagoshima}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She began her work in {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}. Among her major roles in that work is the [[Nurse Joy]]s of the [[Kalos]] [[region]] and [[Clemont's Bunnelby]].
